steps.objective: Adapt only the launch manifest. PupateToken and PupateHook are final and independently reviewed: do not change anything under src/ or test/. Set the pool fee tier to the policy allowlist (12500) if the manifest's differs, keep tickSpacing 60, and keep the hook's constructor arguments: the PoolManager, the Cocoon address as sink, the timelock as owner.
acceptanceCriteria: No file under src/ or test/ is modified
launch.json's fee tier is on the policy allowlist
PupateHook's constructor arguments are the PoolManager, the Cocoon sink and the timelock owner

input.objective: Pupate: a Uniswap v4 hook (PupateHook) that taxes the ETH side of every trade in the launch pool and hands the tax to a pre-deployed vault (Cocoon). The vault buys Identity MD seats on Seaport 1.6 at the price the IMD oracle attests, lists each seat at a falling price, and burns PUPATE with the proceeds. Deploy PupateToken (plain ERC-20, 1,000,000,000 supply, 18 decimals) and PupateHook from launch.json at the base commit; the hook's constructor takes the PoolManager, the Cocoon address as sink and the 48-hour timelock as owner (both deployed before the launch). Buy tax opens at 99% and falls one point per minute to a standing 6%; sells pay 6% from the first block; the owner can only lower the tax. Liquidity may be added only in the block that opens the pool. Contracts carry 214 Foundry tests, invariants, a mainnet-fork test of the Seaport path, and two independent reviews (docs/REVIEW.md).
